correctness.rationale: I reconstructed the stationary velocity-resolved telegraph densities A_sigma=(lambda+sigma*r/v)/4 on x>0, Poisson (0,1) mark thinning, and the no-reset/last-reset renewal decomposition. The conditional velocity free telegraph resolvent integrates to the claimed transform in q=s+r. The zero-lag covariance rho/(2lambda), right slope -rho*(v*lambda+r)/(4lambda), nonzero plateau rho/(8lambda), and branch-point coefficient were checked algebraically, including cancellation of the apparent pole at s=-r. Independent high-precision de Hoog inversion at rho=1.4,r=0.7,gamma=1.3,v=2 gave C(0.2)=0.7524873679115 and C(2)=0.3143533762853, agreeing with recorded simulation-scale values. The bivariate Poisson generating function follows from independent marked anchors, not from assuming independent Q(0),Q(t). The branch asymptotic is fixed-parameter for gamma,r>0.
